# Gas Manipulation Atmospherics has a wide range of tools and equipment for handling gases across the station.
[bold]Warning: unwrenching most devices that contain gas will [color=red]release the gas[/color] into the atmosphere.[/bold] You can safely unwrench [textlink="canisters" link="GasCanisters"], [textlink="portable scrubbers" link="PortableScrubber"], [textlink="condensers" link="GasCondensing"], and [textlink="thermomachines" link="Thermomachines"].
## Pipes
[color=#999999][italic]Move gases from one place to another[italic][/color]
## Pumps
[color=#999999][italic]Force gases from one place to another[italic][/color]
## Atmospheric Intake and Output
[color=#999999][italic]Inject and extract gases from an existing atmosphere or a vacuum[italic][/color]
## Valves
[color=#999999][italic]Control the flow of gas through pipes[italic][/color]
## Mixing and Filtering
[color=#999999][italic]Change the composition of gases[italic][/color]
## Gas Canisters
[color=#999999][italic]Store and transport gas for convenient use by the crew[italic][/color]
## Thermomachines and Radiators
[color=#999999][italic]Change the temperature of gases in a pipe network or the atmosphere[italic][/color]
## Gas Condensation
[color=#999999][italic]Condense gases for later use[italic][/color]
